Watchlist tickers with a space in them (NOVO B, ERIC B, ASSA B, INVE B, INDU C, LATO B, KINV B, HEXA B, SEB A, SWED A, HM B, SAAB B) are Excel's raw entity name, not a fetchable ticker symbol - these will fail every screen/valuation fetch until corrected. Replace each with its real exchange-suffixed symbol (e.g. 'SEB A' -> 'SEB-A.ST', 'HM B' -> 'HM-B.ST') - verify the exchange per name, don't assume .ST for all of them (e.g. Novo Nordisk is Copenhagen-listed, '.CO', not '.ST').
